findings.obligation: P6: RELEASING.md R-1 and R-2 and deploy/k8s/README.md describe setting up Slack AND Matrix from Instance admin > Integrations in the browser, with the environment settings as the optional operator alternative; expectation E13 adds that an operator 'can finish both integrations by following only those browser instructions'.
findings.observation: Non-blocking for craft; unresolved for completion. I read both documents at ab6fe1b. The Slack half of P6 is already discharged (RELEASING.md:419 R-2 names /admin/instance/integrations, the pasted manifest, the three credentials entered on that page and 'every replica picks it up without a restart'; RELEASING.md:379 marks the SLACK_* trio optional; deploy/k8s/README.md:108 says an instance admin opens /admin/instance/integrations, generates the secrets key and enters the Slack app). The Matrix half is not: grep for Matrix returns exactly one line in each document (RELEASING.md:363 and deploy/k8s/README.md:97), both the same 'Slack and Matrix credentials are sealed under a secrets key' sentence. Neither document tells an operator anywhere that Matrix is connected in the browser, nor where, so an operator who follows only R-1, R-2 and the Kubernetes Integrations section cannot finish Matrix. The S2 acceptance row's claim that 'Both documents already read this way' is therefore true of Slack and the secrets key and false of Matrix, and because the row is NotTested with an examiner owner, no check of this delivery would catch it.
findings.remediation: Choose one and record it before EXAMINE: either add the missing sentence to RELEASING.md R-2 (and the deploy/k8s/README.md Integrations step 4) saying that, once the secrets key exists under Instance admin > Integrations, a workspace admin connects that workspace's own Matrix bot on the workspace integrations page, which is what the shipped instance page already tells its reader; or restate P6 and its S2 row to promise only what the documents do carry for Matrix, namely the secrets key generated in the browser, and leave the workspace-level Matrix connection out of the operator documents. Do not pin either document's prose in a test; the examiner disposition stays correct either way.
